The '''Hismaul system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]], a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="EAOC" /> and the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]].<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> It was home to a creature known as the [[Hismauli hawk-snake]].<ref name="EGTW" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hismaul system was established in the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which placed the system in grid square Q-16.<ref name="EAOC" />
